d:
Rehana khan bharat ki gini-chuni mahila stant draivron men se ek hain. vah desh bhar ke melon men apni motarsaikil se ‘maut ke kuen’ men kartab dikhati hain aur bhir ka manoranjan karti hain. magar aise khatarnak kam ke bavjud ek achchhi aamadni kamana unke lie aasan nahin hota.
Agar aapko vidiyo pasand aaya aur aage bhi aisi dilchasp vidiyo dekhna chahte hain to hamen sabsakraib karna mat bhulie.
